plugins.name: desktop-control
plugins.description: Control the whole desktop over MCP: screenshots, mouse, keyboard, apps and AppleScript. macOS and Linux/X11, with an on-screen notice naming whoever is driving.

plugins.name: claude-backend-indicator
plugins.description: Says in every session whether the turn goes to your Anthropic subscription or to a local LiteLLM gateway, and ships the wrapper that routes it. Reads the session's own environment, because the model label can disagree with where the request lands.
